```{r}
#functions for filtering step
AllFalse <- function(vector){all(vector == FALSE)}
TwoOrMoreTrue <- function(vector){sum(vector == TRUE) >= 2}

# annotating function - from Affymetrix transcript cluster ID to NetAffx gene symbol
AnnotateGenes <- function(transcript.IDs){
    transcripts <- as.character(transcript.clusters.NetAffx.32[transcript.clusters.NetAffx.32$transcript_cluster_id %in% transcript.IDs, ]$transcript_cluster_id)
    gene.assignment <- strsplit(as.character(transcript.clusters.NetAffx.32[transcript.clusters.NetAffx.32$transcript_cluster_id %in% transcript.IDs, ]$gene_assignment) , "//")
    gene.symbols <- unlist(lapply(gene.assignment, function(assignment){
    length <- length(assignment)
    if(length > 2){
        HGNC <- seq(from = 2, to = length, by = 5)
        assignment <- unique(trim(assignment[HGNC]))
        assignment <- paste(assignment, collapse = "/")
    } else{
        assignment <- "--"} 
    }))
    gene.symbols[is.na(gene.symbols)]	<- "--"
    annotate <- data.frame(transcript = transcripts, symbol = gene.symbols)
    annotate
}

# variables defined for biomaRt
ensembl <- useMart('ensembl', dataset = 'hsapiens_gene_ensembl')
attributes.region	<- c("external_gene_id", "chromosome_name", "start_position", "end_position", "ensembl_gene_id")							
filter.symbol <- "hgnc_symbol"

# function needed for visualization functions below
AnnotateGeneSymbol <- function(symbol.to.annotate){
    annotated.genes <- getBM(attributes = attributes.region, filters = filter.symbol, values = symbol.to.annotate, mart = ensembl)
    annotated.genes
}
								
GetIntensities <- function(trans, type = "DE"){
    if (!type %in% c("DE", "ANOSVAprobe", "ANOSVAprobeset", "FIRMA")){
        print("Wrong model type")
    } else {
        if(type == "DE"|type == "ANOSVAprobe"|type == "FIRMA"){
            if(!exists("unitIntensities")){
                load(file= paste(output.folder, "CoreProbeIntensities.Rdata", sep = "/"))
            }
            gene.intensities <- unitIntensities[[as.character(trans)]]
            gene.intensities <- lapply(gene.intensities, function(sublist){sublist$intensities})
            gene.intensities <- do.call(rbind, gene.intensities)
            gene.intensities <- log2(gene.intensities)
            if (!type == "FIRMA"){  
                mean.intensities <- lapply(groups, function(group){
                    if(length(group) > 1){
                        apply(gene.intensities[, group], 1, mean)
                    } else {
                        gene.intensities[, group]
                    }
                })
                mean.intensities <- t(do.call(rbind, mean.intensities))
                gene.intensities <- cbind(gene.intensities, mean.intensities)
            }
        } else {# for ANOSVA probeset
            if(!exists("exFit")){
                load(file= paste(output.folder, "CoreExonIntensities.Rdata", sep = "/"))
            }
            gene.intensities <- subset(exFit, unitName == trans, select = -c(1:5)) 
            gene.intensities <- log2(gene.intensities)
            mean.intensities <- lapply(groups, function(group){
                if(length(group) > 1){
                    apply(gene.intensities[,group], 1, mean)
                } else {
                    gene.intensities[, group]
                }
            })
            mean.intensities <- t(do.call(rbind, mean.intensities))
            gene.intensities <- as.matrix(cbind(gene.intensities, mean.intensities))
        }
    }
    gene.intensities
}
```

# Preprocessing & Summarization

```{r}
chipType <- "HuEx-1_0-st-v2" 
#** user-defined .CDF file: change tags parameter
cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType(chipType, tags = "coreR3,A20071112,EP")
cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$byName(ds, cdf = cdf) 

# remove samples with NA in either C1 or Type_of_Death column
sample.info <- sample.info[!is.na(sample.info$C1), ]
sample.info <- sample.info[!is.na(sample.info$Type_of_Death), ]
              
# ** choose subset of the dataset from SampleInformation.txt, if needed
cel.files <- cs$Names
if (!all(cel.files %in% sample.info$celFile)){
 cs <- extract(cs, cel.files %in% sample.info$Filename)
}

# match order in sample.info and in cel set
name.match <- match(cs$Names, sample.info$Filename)
sample.info <- sample.info[name.match, ]

# background correction
bc <- RmaBackgroundCorrection(cs) 
csBC <- process(bc, verbose = verbose) 

# quantile normalization
qn <- QuantileNormalization(csBC, typesToUpdate = "pm")
csN <- process(qn, verbose = verbose)

# summarization
# transcript cluster level: do only if FIRMA scores/ transcript intensities needed

# FIRMA scores
if (!file.exists(paste(output.folder, "FIRMAscores.Rdata", sep = "/"))){
    plmTr  <- ExonRmaPlm(csN, mergeGroups = TRUE, tag = "coreProbesetsGeneExpression")
    fit(plmTr, verbose = verbose) 
    firma <- FirmaModel(plmTr)
    fit(firma, verbose = verbose)
    fs <- getFirmaScores(firma)
    firma.scores <- extractDataFrame(fs)
    names(firma.scores) <- c(names(firma.scores)[1:3], sample.info$Filename)
    save(firma.scores, file = paste(output.folder, "FIRMAscores.Rdata", sep = "/"))
    rm(list = c("plmTr", "firma", "fs", "firma.scores"))
}

# probeset level - do not run
#plmEx  <- ExonRmaPlm(csN, mergeGroups = FALSE, 
#            tag = "coreProbesetsExonExpression")			
#fit(plmEx, verbose = verbose) 

if(!file.exists(file= paste(output.folder, "CoreProbeIntensities.Rdata", sep = "/"))){
    unitIntensities <- readUnits(csN, verbose=verbose) 
    save(unitIntensities, file= paste(output.folder, "CoreProbeIntensities.Rdata", sep = "/"))
    rm("unitIntensities")
}

rm(list = c("bc", "cs", "cel.files", "name.match", "qn", "csBC"))
gc(verbose = FALSE)
```
